title: Bermuda Triangle compass deviations from ancient meteorites

tellings.quote: my personal belief is that there were probably in ancient ancient ancient times metal uh meteorites that landed under the ocean floor

plain: Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor, thinks the compass problems people report in the Bermuda Triangle, a stretch of ocean off Florida famous for stories of lost ships and planes, may come from metal meteorites that "landed under the ocean floor" in "ancient ancient ancient times." He tells Michels it is his "personal belief," which would give the area's strange reputation a natural cause.
